name: hypertask_sections
does: List, read, create, update or delete board columns, including their completion and automatic-assignment settings.
use_when: Use when the board structure must change or when you need the tasks in one column.
do_not_use_when: Do not use to move a ticket between columns; use hypertask_tasks update with section_id instead.
parameters_and_caveats: action selects an operation; input contains only that operation’s documented fields. response_format defaults to concise for reads; detailed retains full fields. limit defaults to 20 (maximum 50) and offset defaults to 0 for bounded read results; use returned pagination or narrower filters. Identifiers and required fields depend on the selected action; writes keep existing authorization and confirmation rules.
